// Generated by `cairn export playwright --project`. Source: flows/data.yml
// Intent: data verifiers export

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { cairnProjectPath } from "../lib/projectRoot";
import { cairnSplice } from "../lib/splice";
import { cairnCapture } from "../lib/probe";
import { cairnFilePath } from "../lib/dataPath";
import { cairnRefs, cairnAssertValue } from "../lib/dataValue";
import { cairnHttpVerify, cairnExpectRequest } from "../lib/dataHttp";
import { cairnAssertHttpJson } from "../lib/dataHttpJson";
import { cairnTrackRequests, cairnAssertNetwork } from "../lib/dataNetwork";
import { cairnAssertFile } from "../lib/dataFile";


test("data_checks", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(282000);

  const requests = cairnTrackRequests(page);

  // Values captured by request/eval/download `assign:` for later ${…} splices.
  let cairnCaptures_row: unknown;
  let cairnRequests_created: unknown;
  let cairnArtifacts_csv: unknown;
  let cairnCaptures_job: unknown;
  let cairnNetwork_sent: unknown;

  // --- steps ---
  await test.step("open", async () => {
    await page.goto("/start");
  });
  await test.step("row", async () => {
    cairnCaptures_row = await cairnCapture(page, "table", { "by": "role", "role": "table" }, { timeoutMs: 5000, includeHidden: false });
  });
  await test.step("create", async () => {
    {
      // request step (created) — page.request shares browser context cookies
      const cairnResponse = await page.request.fetch("/api/restock", { method: "POST", timeout: 30000, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, data: { "quantity": 5 } });
      requests.push({ url: cairnResponse.url(), method: "POST", status: cairnResponse.status(), timestamp: Date.now(), postData: JSON.stringify({ "quantity": 5 }) });
      cairnRequests_created = { url: cairnResponse.url(), method: "POST", status: cairnResponse.status(), ok: cairnResponse.status() >= 200 && cairnResponse.status() < 400, headers: cairnResponse.headers(), body: ((text) => { if (text === null || text === undefined) { return null; } try { return JSON.parse(text) as unknown; } catch { return text; } })(await cairnResponse.text()) };
    }
  });
  await test.step("poll_job", async () => {
    {
      const cairnScope = { responses: { "created": cairnRequests_created } };
      const cairnCall = cairnRefs({ "url": "/api/jobs/${requests.created.body.id}", "json": { "status": "done" } }, cairnScope, "expect.request");
      await cairnExpectRequest(page, { method: "GET", url: String(cairnCall.url) }, { json: cairnCall.json }, 5000);
    }
  });
  await test.step("download", async () => {
    {
      const download = await Promise.all([
        page.waitForEvent("download", { timeout: 30000 }),
        page.getByRole("button", { name: "Export" }).first().click(),
      ]).then(([download]) => download);
      const downloadPath = test.info().outputPath("cairn-run", "downloads", "x.csv");
      await download.saveAs(downloadPath);
      cairnArtifacts_csv = { path: downloadPath, relativePath: "downloads/x.csv" };
    }
  });

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // row_is_there: the captured row
  await test.step("row_is_there", async () => {
    {
      const cairnScope = { responses: { "created": cairnRequests_created }, captures: { "row": cairnCaptures_row } };
      cairnAssertValue(cairnRefs("${captures.row}", cairnScope, "value actual"), cairnRefs({ "rowCount": 1, "rows[0].SKU": "${requests.created.body.sku}" }, cairnScope, "value expectations"), "${captures.row}");
    }
  });

  // api_says_done: the API
  await test.step("api_says_done", async () => {
    await expect(async () => {
      {
        const cairnScope = { responses: { "created": cairnRequests_created } };
        const cairnCall = cairnRefs({ "url": "/api/jobs/${requests.created.body.id}", "json": { "status": "done" } }, cairnScope, "http");
        const cairnReply = await cairnHttpVerify({ method: "GET", url: String(cairnCall.url), timeoutMs: 15000, source: { name: "demo_api", baseUrl: "http://localhost:8787" }, baseUrl: test.info().project.use.baseURL }, { status: 200, json: cairnCall.json });
        cairnCaptures_job = { status: cairnReply.status, body: cairnReply.body };
      }
    }).toPass({ timeout: 5000, intervals: [250] });
  });

  // job_value: the job reply
  await test.step("job_value", async () => {
    {
      const cairnScope = { captures: { "job": cairnCaptures_job } };
      cairnAssertValue(cairnRefs("${captures.job.body}", cairnScope, "value actual"), { "quantity": 5 }, "${captures.job.body}");
    }
  });

  // one_post: one restock was sent
  await test.step("one_post", async () => {
    test.info().annotations.push({ type: "cairn:network", description: JSON.stringify({ outcome: "one_post", matched: requests.filter((r: { url: string; method: string }) => r.method.toUpperCase() === "POST" && r.url.includes("/api/restock")).length }) });
    {
      cairnNetwork_sent = await cairnAssertNetwork(requests, { "urlContains": "/api/restock", "method": "POST", "status": { "equals": 202 }, "body": { "json": { "quantity": 5 } }, "count": 1, "assign": "sent" }, {});
    }
  });

  // sent_at: the send time is known
  await test.step("sent_at", async () => {
    {
      const cairnScope = { networkAssigns: { "sent": cairnNetwork_sent } };
      cairnAssertValue(cairnRefs("${network.sent.count}", cairnScope, "value actual"), { "$": 1 }, "${network.sent.count}");
    }
  });

  // exports_a_file: the export landed
  await test.step("exports_a_file", async () => {
    await cairnAssertFile("${artifacts.csv.path}", cairnFilePath(`${cairnSplice(cairnArtifacts_csv, ["path"])}`, true, test.info().outputPath("cairn-run"), cairnProjectPath("flows")), "sku", 2000);
  });

  // json_matches: httpJson with a regex
  await test.step("json_matches", async () => {
    {
      const res = await page.request.get("/api/me");
      expect(res.ok()).toBeTruthy();
      const body = ((text) => { if (text === null || text === undefined) { return null; } try { return JSON.parse(text) as unknown; } catch { return text; } })(await res.text());
      cairnAssertHttpJson(body, { jsonPath: "$.name", matches: "^A" });
    }
  });

});
